items.source:
This package contains the schema that is defined by a set of classes, representing
nodes and relationships and their properties.
items.translation: 该包包含由一组类定义的架构，这些类表示节点、关系及其属性。

items.source: The direction of the defined relationship.
Enumeration of the direction a relationship can take.
items.translation: 枚举关系可采取的方向。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，这些常量按照声明顺序排列。
